content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.

content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.

content.hebrew: שֵׁ֒שֶׁת יְמֵי הַחֹל : בָּרָא יְסוֹד הַכֹּל
content.transliteration: Sheshet yemé haḥol : Bara yesod hakkol
content.english: On the six profane days, He created the foundation for everything.

content.hebrew: מוֹפֵת וְאוֹת לַכֹּל : בָּרָא אֱלֹהֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Mofet ve’ot lakkol : Bara elohenu.
content.english: A miracle and a sign for all our Lord created.

content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.

content.hebrew: הֵ֒א אוֹת אֲשֶׁר הִמְצִיא : מִלֹּא לְיֵשׁ הוֹצִיא
content.transliteration: Hé ot asher himtsi : Millo leyesh hotsi
content.english: Behold the sign He produced. He drew being out of nothing.

content.hebrew: מוֹרֶה לְסוֹד מַמְצִיא : מִי צוּר כְּיוֹצְרֵנוּ:
content.transliteration: Moré lesod mamtsi : Mi tsur keyotserenu.
content.english: A teacher of the Creator’s secret: who is truly a Rock, as our Maker is?

content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.

content.hebrew: בָּ֒חַר לְעַם אֶחָד : יֵחוּד שְׁמוֹ סַהַד
content.transliteration: Baḥar le‘am eḥad : Yeḥud shemo sahad
content.english: He chose one nation to bear witness to His unique name.

content.hebrew: פִּרְסֵם בְּלִי כַחַד : כִּי הוּא אֲדֹנֵנוּ:
content.transliteration: Pirsem beli chaḥad : Ki hu adonenu.
content.english: He made it public without concealment that He is our Lord.

content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.

content.hebrew: גָּ֒בַר מְאֹד חַסְדּוֹ : הוֹרָה שְׁבוּת עַבְדּוֹ
content.transliteration: Gavar me’od ḥasdo : Hora shevut ‘avdo
content.english: His kindness overpowers: He ordered rest for His servant!

content.hebrew: לֵאוּט לְיֵחוּדוֹ : יִעֵד מְעוֹדְדֵנוּ:
content.transliteration: Le’ut leyeḥudo : Yi‘ed me‘odedenu.
content.english: To ponder His oneness, He, the One who strengthens us, designated.

content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.

content.hebrew: י֒וֹם זֶה יְתוּר דֵּעַ : הַשְׂכֵּל וְיָדֹעַ
content.transliteration: Yom zé yetur de’a‘ : Haskel veyado’a‘
content.english: It is a day of added knowledge, of understanding and awareness,

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְמַרְגּוֹעַ : נֹפֶשׁ לְנַפְשֵׁנוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot lemargo’a‘ : Nofesh lenafshenu.
content.english: Dedicated for relaxation, a relief for our souls.

content.hebrew: מִ֒צְוַת יְסוֹד שַׁבָּת : הָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת
content.transliteration: Mitsvat yesod shabbat : Ha’el asher shavat
content.english: The origin of the Sabbath commandment is God, who ceased working.

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לְאוֹת הוּבָאת : בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Lihyot le’ot huvat : Beno levenenu.
content.english: It was given as a sign between Him and us.
